description: Custom field section, groups custom fields of one entity type

id.description: Unique generated identifier for the custom field section

name.description: The name of the custom field section, unique per entity type (case-insensitive)

entityType.description: The entity type, the custom field section is assigned to

order.description: The display order of the section within its entity type, set by the server: new sections are appended, PUT /custom-field-sections sets the order of the given list
